family_folds: original E73 SHA256 modulo3; all same-seed branches/states remain together
model: new jointly learned float32 MLP: public state/candidate ->128 SiLU ->64 SiLU ->1 logit; no frozen BC representation

training.objective: unweighted BCE over the predeclared hierarchical training distribution; final checkpoint only

sampling: Both arms uniform fit family then uniform first-card branch. root_only uses forced root. root_plus_later uses root with probability1/2, else uniform available later act then uniform retained row; branches without later rows use root. No win oversampling or length weighting.
deploy: Change only Act1 first-fight last card reward; greedy Q logit, ties to parent. Whole-menu unknown card IDs relative to fit-root support fall back to parent. Native feature and choice verification before evaluation.
gate: Each arm must gain at least30/1536 versus parent out of fold and descriptive paired p<.025. No holdout fitting/grid; passing final model and historical holdout admission require later explicit recorded root decision.
limits: Fit-only development; no unseen acceptance claim. A passing fold screen is not model adoption. Parent actor/search and all other decisions frozen. Raw public input excludes hidden game state.
